title: Design: image intake, local vision route, privacy and taint
goal: One page fixes how an image enters chat, which model reads it, where it is kept and how its text is treated
acceptance: Parked 2026-11-26 (owner decision in chat): this step does not start until the owner picks a use for F-142 (see the candidate uses in the record).

Owner decisions 2026-11-26 in chat: fpvbuddy:F-023 "A" (retire the on-device assistant and the vision demo), with "vision capabilities ideally on nerv too"; Italian is required for every model-facing feature (the owner uses all modules in Italian).

docs/decisions/vision-in-chat.md covers: intake per channel (Telegram photo without an attach caption, PWA chat, POST /api/chat), limits (reuse photos.ts: 5 MiB, JPEG/PNG/WebP by magic bytes), EXIF/GPS stripped before storage, local store and retention (default: chat images deleted after 7 days unless attached to an item; stated as a default the owner can change)

Route: only a local vision-capable model (gemma4:12b on Ollama, which accepts images) reads images; no cloud or remote-provider route ever receives one; with no local vision model the reply says so in the owner's language (Italian by default) and nothing is sent elsewhere

Taint: text read from an image (a sign, a receipt, a screenshot) is untrusted data with tainted provenance: never an instruction, never enough on its own to propose or approve a tool call, and any memory fact derived from it is stored tainted (src/memory.ts)

Gauntlet: no image-understanding pack exists in gauntlet-protocol (only image-generation-v1, which uses gemma4:12b as a judge); the page names the pack NERV needs (vision-understanding, Italian and English) as gauntlet-protocol work to be opened there
privacy: Images stay on the owner's machines: no cloud route receives an image; tests use invented images generated in the test (no personal photos, no EXIF from real devices) and no secrets.
escalation: Material scope growth or effort increase goes to the owner before adoption

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-26 at agent speed: one decision page from existing photos.ts limits, Telegram photo handling and memory taint. Not a measurement.
